title: Have you been able to use your phone?
content: A lot of dream discussions have been around using technology or rather not being able to exactly. This being extremely odd as it is intertwined in everything we do daily. Well last night is the first an only time I can remember or think of being able to use my phone. I called my friend to see where he was. No one answered but I was able to dial and use the screen. I don’t remember the number. I went record shopping soon after at the book store.
